photos.sourceDate: Image asset key starts 2025-09-28; capture date not confirmed.
photos.observations: Resident-posted night photo. A curved ribbed fascia carries illuminated SUMMIT PRUGIO lettering. Warm continuous edge lighting sits above a pale stone base; dark tower cladding and light vertical strips are visible above, with planted beds and a broad paved walk in front. Actual complex is visually identified by the physical sign.

photos.sourceDate: Image asset key starts 2025-09-28; capture date not confirmed.
photos.category: exterior/site — shared lounge entrance and courtyard
photos.observations: Resident-posted night photo. The SUMMIT LOUNGE sign fronts a low community building; tower numbers 102, 103, and 106 frame the courtyard. Shows layered tower massing, trimmed pines, paving, warm entry light, and the low podium/community frontage.

photos.sourceDate: Image asset key starts 2025-09-28; capture date not confirmed.
photos.observations: Resident-posted night photo. Building identifiers 103 and 105, a long curved covered community frontage, repeated narrow window bays, illuminated fascia, and planted ground plane are visible. This is a distinct angle from photo 1.

photos.sourceDate: Image asset key starts 2025-08-22; capture date not confirmed.
photos.category: exterior/site — wide tower and landscape view
photos.observations: Resident-posted night view in the complex community. Several towers with pale vertical bands and darker window fields rise above a broad planted courtyard. Warm path and podium lighting is visible. Use for massing and landscape composition; nighttime color is not reliable paint evidence.

photos.sourceDate: Image asset key starts 2026-07-05; resident review is associated with the target apartment page.
photos.observations: Resident-posted dusk photo. Tall dark gray tower faces are divided by pale vertical bands; a warm horizontal lighting line marks the landscape/podium edge behind a dense tree canopy. A SUMMIT crown is visible. Strong for silhouette, window rhythm, and night lighting, not daylight color.

photos.sourceDate: Image asset key starts 2026-04-19; resident review is associated with the target apartment page.
photos.observations: Resident-posted night site photo with towers at the frame edge, a small illuminated bridge, curved paved routes, planted mounds, and warm low-level lighting. The site context is clear, though tower façade details are partially cropped.

photos.sourceDate: Image asset key starts 2025-12-05; resident review is associated with the target apartment page.
photos.observations: Resident-posted evening terrace image: dark outdoor lounge seating, glass guardrail, linear warm lighting along a curved planted court, and tower faces beyond. Useful for podium/courtyard relationship; nighttime warmth should not be treated as façade paint color.

photos.sourceDate: Image asset key starts 2025-12-15; resident review is associated with the target apartment page.
photos.category: exterior/site — internal pedestrian path and towers
photos.observations: Resident-posted dusk photo looking along a landscaped pedestrian path between tower blocks. Warm bollards and path-edge lighting trace the route; tower silhouettes and the shared park space are visible. A site/path reference rather than a façade color reference.

photos.sourceDate: Resident post dated 2025-06-19; text says the photo was shared by the association. Capture date not separately confirmed.
photos.category: exterior/site — daylight courtyard and tower bases
photos.observations: Daylight target-specific photo, with tower numbers 104 and 105 visible. Shows dark slate/blue-gray façade fields and black stone podium, pale cool-gray vertical wall blades, regular narrow window grid, dark slim glass railing, curved pale stone sunken-court wall, and small planted trees. Strongest daylight palette reference.

photos.sourceDate: Official Daewoo/Prugio article dated 2026-03-03; caption identifies the photo as La Cherbo Summit sunken and amenity space.
photos.category: exterior/site — sunken courtyard viewed from lounge glazing
photos.observations: Officially attributed completed-site photograph. A dark interior lounge opens through full-height black mullions to a pale stone sunken court; a planted island with a shaped pine sits beneath a layered soffit/curved walkway. The centered landscape bowl is useful for communal-courtyard structure.

photos.sourceDate: Official Daewoo/Prugio article dated 2026-03-03; caption identifies the photo as Summit amenity interior.
photos.observations: Officially attributed shared lounge, not a private dwelling. Shows charcoal slatted walls, dark timber, gray stone flooring, floor-to-ceiling black-framed glazing, layered low seating, and a long linear light. Counted as a public communal-space architecture reference only.
